reviews.title: Solid fans, but the design is even cooler
reviews.comment: The fans are about as good as any other in functionality and the outer ring LEDs outside of the fan itself are pretty cool as well. That said, the coolest part about these are the super sick daisy chain connections. I’m running a Lian Li O11 Dynamic case and it’s recommended to fill it up with fans to prevent pockets of hot air filling up. So I’ve got three fans on the side and three fans lining the bottom, not including the three fans on my Lian Li Galahad 360 mm AIO at the top of the case. That’s a lot of fans that would normally require individual connectors…. BUT the UNI fan daisy chain removes the need for that. It’s incredibly easy to just put the connector on one end, and just connect the other two fans in a line with a simple slide and click, and that one signal cable feeds all three fans. Super handy for cable management!
reviews.author: thejclay13

reviews.title: Great fans, albeit a bit pricy
reviews.comment: 5* and I would definitely buy again. These fans are quiet, have a decent static pressure for radiator use, and subjectively I think they look fantastic. They're a little pricey but worth it, in my opinion. Software is a bit janky and I guess could be a half point off for that....but the fan performance makes up for it!! I'd buy them again.....but with 10 in my case, I think I'm good for a bit ;)
reviews.author: Matt_AK

reviews.title: Best computer fans
reviews.comment: The ability to chain these fans together while only using one connector for each set of fans makes these the best fans for me. You may like the RGB/LEDs on other fans such as Corsair, Cooler Master, Phanteks, ThermalTake, etc., but the Lian-Li Uni fans help reduce so much cable clutter and makes cable management such a breeze that I kinda refuse to look at any other fan manufacturers until these daisy chain fans/connectors becomes more commonplace. But regardless of these fans being the best in terms of cable management, the LEDs that feed through fan blades on these fans actually look much better in person than in pictures, and the accent lighting in the corners looks absolutely fantastic. The only dislike I have with these fans is that AL140 fans, I had heard/read on forums, were supposed to be dropping this year, but there hasn't been any official notice yet.
reviews.author: Joshua Shorey

reviews.title: beautiful, and efficient!
reviews.comment: The colors are great, simple to put in and the best part? They are like lego's and you can snap them together to reduce the wiring needed in your case! got a spot where all 3 can fit? perfect! 1 wire! got 3 more spots where 3 can put together? Again just 3 more wires ( would be 9 otherwise and 12 altogether if you add the first set) I believe it says it can handle 16 at once! (wouldnt recommend unless you are going a SUPER build haha) For noise: None. I have never heard these unless I was messing around and jammed my finger into the blades on accident. Keeps my computer running cool and they look fantastic as well and minimalizing the cords involved!
reviews.author: Nicky Hawkins
